newsitem.title: USA: Morgan Stanley strategist Biggs alters allocation.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Stanley strategist Biggs alters allocation.

text.p: Morgan Stanley said global strategist Barton Biggs reduced the representation of stocks and raised the amount of cash and bonds held in the firm's global asset allocation portfolio.

The firm said Biggs reduced the portfolio's equity allocation to 56 percent from 74 percent and raised bonds to 29 percent from 26 percent. In addition, the portfolio now includes 15 percent in cash, versus no cash holdings prior to the action.
With respect to geography, Morgan Stanley said Biggs underweighted the United States and Europe in the portfolio, recommending overweightings for Japan, non-Japan Asia and emerging markets holdings.
